Fix Browse button text clipped in image popup and make form inputs full-width

The CSS rule .jodit-tab.jodit-tab_empty { min-width: 220px } never matched
because tabs.ts created a child div with class jodit-tab_empty instead of
adding the class to the .jodit-tab element itself. This caused the popup to
remain too narrow (193px), clipping the Browse button text.

Also added flex: 1 to inputs/selects inside UIBlock so form fields stretch
to full width in link popup and other forms.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1318
New version 4.9.19 Read more https://github.com/xdan/jodit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Add regression tests for limit.limit event

Verified that the limit.limit event fires correctly for limitChars
and limitWords in all scenarios (keydown, change, insertHTML).

Closes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1181

Fix custom cell popup buttons not working when referenced by name

Cell popup buttons (valign, splitv, merge, addcolumn, addrow, delete)
were only defined as inline objects in Config.prototype.popup.cells but
not registered as global controls. When users customized popup.cells
with string names via Jodit.atom(), the toolbar couldn't resolve them
and fell back to raw execCommand — causing 'delete' to act as backspace
and other buttons to be non-functional.

Register cell button definitions as global controls so they can be
referenced by name in custom popup configurations.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1328

test(popup): regression test for inner popup position with allowTabNavigation

The misalignment from #1265 (inner popup appended into its trigger button
inside the outer popup, whose CSS transform shifts position:fixed
coordinates) no longer reproduces — fixed in 4.12.8 by the
getFixedPositionOffset containing-block compensation (#1350).

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1265

test(resizer): regression test for hiding resize frame on iframe content scroll

The floating-frame scenario from #1266 (iframe + editHTMLDocumentMode,
frame stays on screen after scrolling) does not reproduce on the current
version — the iframe plugin proxies the inner window scroll event into
the main window where the resizer hides the frame.

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1266

fix(resizer): jerky image resizing in iframe mode

During a drag mousemove events arrive both from the host window (pointer
over the resize frame) and proxied from the editor's iframe (pointer over
the content), but the iframe-viewport coordinate correction was applied to
all of them, shifting host-window events by the workplace offset.
Apply the correction only to events originating from the iframe window.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1264

fix(resize-handler): jerky editor resizing in iframe mode

Mousemove events proxied from the editor's iframe carry iframe-viewport
coordinates and were mixed as-is with host-window ones while dragging the
statusbar resize handle, so the editor height jumped between two values.
Shift proxied coordinates into the host space (checked via e.view), same
approach as the resizer fix for #1264.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1287

fix(dialog): clamp interactive resize to a minimum size

A dialog could be resized smaller than its own header, content and
footer, so the footer buttons ended up outside the dialog box. The
resize is now clamped to dialog.minWidth/minHeight when set, otherwise
to the sum of header, content CSS min-height and footer sizes.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1262

fix(langs): Turkish Word-paste prompt was in German

langs/tr.js contained a copy of the German translation for the
'pasted content is coming from a Microsoft Word/Excel document'
prompt. Replaced with the proper Turkish text.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1245

fix(paste): plain text with a stray < lost everything after the bracket

Plain-text clipboard content was inserted through the HTML path, so a
bare '<' started an unclosed tag that swallowed the rest of the string.
When the clipboard contains only text/plain (and it is not actual HTML),
special characters are now escaped before insertion; nl2brInPlainText
conversion applies after escaping.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1227

test(paste): regression tests for Word inter-word spaces in separate spans

The space-loss scenario from #1230 (Word puts spaces into their own
letter-spacing spans) does not reproduce on the current version —
verified with the full table HTML from the issue in insert_as_html,
insert_clear_html and insert_only_text modes.

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1230

test(select-cells): regression test for cells popup surviving fast drag-select

The popup-disappears scenario from #1174 (selection changes right before
mouseup) does not reproduce on the current version — covered the pending
trailing throttled mousemove, the Firefox redraw-hack cleanup, debounced
history changes and the click dispatched on the common TR ancestor.

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1174

test(color): regression test for applying color over a selection with a table

The last-row-keeps-color scenario from #1221 does not reproduce on the
current version — applying forecolor over a selection that includes a
whole table recolors text in every cell, including td-level inline
colors as produced by Word.

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1221

fix(clean-html): TypeError when a disallowed tag with attributes meets allowTags map

With cleanHTML.allowTags configured as a per-tag attribute map
({p: true, a: {href: true}}), any tag outside the list that carried
attributes (e.g. <meta charset> from pasted e-mail HTML) made the
attribute filter read allow[nodeName][attr] from undefined — the cleanup
worker threw on every pass and disallowed tags were never removed.
Skip such tags in the attribute filter; the tags filter removes them.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1224

fix(inline-popup): keep the selection toolbar open after a button click

Clicking a button in the toolbarInlineForSelection popup (e.g. Bold)
applied the command but the unconditional closeAllPopups closed the
toolbar even though the selection was still active. When the click
originated inside a popup, the selection toolbar is now reopened while
the selection is not collapsed.

Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1238

test(selection): regression test for insertHTML after the editor lost focus

The insert-at-start scenario from #1239 (insertHTML from a click handler
on a non-focusable element) does not reproduce on the current version —
the saved caret position is correctly restored before insertion.

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1239

fix(clean-html): do not load images while sanitizing the assigned value Every editor.value assignment parsed the HTML into a live-document div, so the browser fetched every in the value — with wrappers that sync the value on each change (jodit-react onChange) image URLs were re-requested on every keystroke. Parse the value in an inert document (implementation.createHTMLDocument) instead, which never loads sub-resources. Dom.isElement/isHTMLElement no longer require a browsing context so the sanitizer works on inert nodes; the safeHTML hook is now fired as an event. Fixes https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1237

test(image-processor): regression tests for base64 image blob: round-trip

The base64-to-URL scenario from #1244 does not reproduce in the core
editor — the blob: URL stays in the view only and the data URI is
restored in editor.value, the source element, the controlled-value loop
and after destruct (React remount).

Relates to https://github.com/xdan/jodit/issues/1244

test(tooltip): regression test for tooltips inside the inline popup

fix(limit): count spaces toward limitChars when countTextSpaces is on

The limiter computed the char count as words joined without spaces, so
limitChars never counted spaces even with countTextSpaces: true, while
the status-bar counter showed the space-inclusive number. The limiter
now counts characters the same way as the stat counter.

happened from a wrapper re-initialization (Vue/React). The mirror is now
focused only when focus is not already inside another editor or control.

Jodit intercepts copy/cut and serialized only the range contents — a
selection entirely inside the text of a formatted element put bare text
into the clipboard, losing the strong/em/... context that native browser
copy preserves. The copied fragment is now wrapped in shallow clones of
the selection's inline ancestors.

returns the shadow host — so with the `shadowRoot` option the

the color commands committed the color as a pending caret format in an
empty span placed outside the table and the cell text never changed.

nested spans carrying their own Word colors.

natively — the option seemed to have no effect. The editor now cancels
file drops when the option is off.

fix(paste-from-word): recognize real Word and LibreOffice clipboard markup

The detector only matched a Microsoft Word/Excel meta generator or
double-quoted mso- styles combined with font tags, while the raw Word
clipboard fragment uses single-quoted style='mso-…', unquoted
class=MsoNormal, an unquoted ProgId meta and office XML namespaces —
and modern Word emits no font tags at all; LibreOffice content was
never detected. Office content therefore got the generic HTML dialog
instead of the Word one. The detector now recognizes all these markers.

The Paste from clipboard button explicitly requested only the
text/plain flavor from navigator.clipboard.read() even when text/html

the full HTML. The button now prefers the HTML flavor with a
plain-text fallback, going through the same paste pipeline as the
shortcut.

fix(backspace): do not merge paragraph text into the table element

Backspace at the start of a paragraph after a table (or Delete before
one) merged the text into the <table> element itself — it landed after
</tbody>, which is invalid HTML and gets foster-parented out of the
table on the next parse, corrupting the document and causing follow-up
DOM errors. The join now targets the edge table cell (last for
Backspace, first for Delete).

fix(selection): drop conflicting font styles when applying a block format

Applying a heading to a block pasted from an external source seemed to
do nothing — the tag changed, but leftover inline styles like
font-weight: normal; font-size: 24px visually overrode the new format.
Block format application now removes the conflicting font-size and
font-weight inline styles from the block; other styles stay.

fix(inline-popup): position the selection toolbar correctly in iframe mode

The selection toolbar was positioned by range.getBoundingClientRect(),
whose coordinates are iframe-local in iframe: true mode, while the
popup lives in the host document — it opened far away from the
selected text. The iframe offset is now added to the selection bound.

fix(toolbar): run status calculation for getContent controls

Controls rendered through getContent (e.g. the FileBrowser Upload

Upload button stayed enabled even when backend permissions said
otherwise. ToolbarContent.update() now evaluates the control status,
applies it explicitly (the first update runs before the state watchers
attach) and propagates the disabled state to nested form controls.

for an editor created with a custom ownerWindow (inside an iframe) the

Dialog: attach handlers passed via options.events to the emitter

A dialog fires afterOpen/beforeClose on its own emitter (unlike popups,
which fire on the editor emitter), and unlike FileBrowser it never called
attachEvents. So handlers passed via options.events were ignored and the
open/close of a dialog could not be observed from the editor. The Dialog
constructor now calls attachEvents(self.options), letting a plugin forward
the editor's events config to the dialog.

fix(iframe): stop executing scripts of a full document loaded in editHTMLDocumentMode (GHSA-w3xv-x3fm-59ph)

fix(resizer): keep the iframe wrapper sized when the editor starts hidden

The resizer wraps every iframe in a `<jodit>` element and copied
`offsetWidth`/`offsetHeight` into it. Both are 0 while an ancestor has
`display:none`, so an editor created inside a hidden tab pinned the wrapper to
`0x0`. Nothing recomputed it once the container became visible, and the content
after the iframe painted over the video.

The wrapper now falls back to the iframe's own `width`/`height` attributes when
the element cannot be measured, and is left to size itself when there is nothing
to fall back to. Relative values such as `width="100%"` are rejected so they
cannot become a fixed pixel box.

ci(release): wait for npm to publish the version before triggering downstream

`npm publish` returns while the registry is still processing the tarball, so
the version is not resolvable for several minutes afterwards. The downstream
dispatches fired immediately, which made jodit-pro (and the other consumers)
install the *previous* core release while running the tests that came with the
new one. Twice today that produced a red build with nothing actually wrong.

The notify job now polls `npm view jodit@<version>` until the release resolves,
for up to 15 minutes, and only then sends the dispatches. The version comes
from the publish job as a job output.

fix(inline): stop firing `change` on every sync in inline mode (#1486)

In inline mode the source element is the editor container, so
`getElementValue()` returned the container's `innerHTML`: the editor's own
markup, never equal to the value. `setEditorValue()` therefore saw a
difference on every synchronisation and fired `change` even when nothing had
changed, and `__setElementValue()` never recorded the value because it skips
the container.

The spurious `change` reaches every listener. Among them, `select-cells`
clears the cell selection and hides the cells popup on `change`, so pressing
any button in that popup closed it on mouseup, before the button's click.

The value last synchronised to an inline container is now kept on the editor
and returned by `getElementValue()`, so `change` fires only when the value
actually changes.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The `colors` option accepts a flat array, and its documentation uses one, but
the picker put every color of a flat array on its own line. Only a named group
gets the `__group` wrapper, which is what wraps the swatches into rows; a flat
array's swatches went straight into the unstyled `__groups` container, and
each swatch is `display: block`. It has looked this way since the swatches

formatting, or clicking the active swatch again, which only works when the

an empty string, which removes the text or background color of the selection,
or the color of the selected table cells. With `textIcons` it shows the word
instead. Its title reuses the existing `Remove` translation.

The eraser icon moves from the clean-html plugin to the shared icon set, since

fix(image-properties): keep a stylesheet margin when the margins are unchanged (#1511)

The dialog reads each margin from the image's inline style and shows 0 when
there isn't one, but Apply compared the field with the computed margin. A
margin set by a stylesheet, such as the spacing around a floated image,
always differed, so it was overwritten with `margin: 0px` even when nothing
was changed.

Apply now compares with the inline value the dialog read, so it writes a
margin only when the user changes one.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(image-processor): remove the caret's invisible text when selecting an image (#1513)

`insertImage` leaves the caret after the image in an invisible-space text
node. Clicking the image selects it, and with that text still after a block
image, Safari also highlights the rest of the image's line, from its right
edge to the edge of the editor.

The text only held a caret, which the selection replaces, so it's now removed
from beside the image before the image is selected.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(focus): keep the caret where a click puts it when focus comes back (#1515)

With saveSelectionOnBlur, the selection saved on blur was restored on every
focus. Chrome has already placed the caret for a click by the time focus
fires, so a click back into the editor moved the caret to the old selection
instead, and typing replaced whatever had been selected.

When focus comes from a mousedown or touchstart in the editor, the saved
markers are now removed rather than restored. Focus that comes back any other
way still restores the selection.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(inline-popup): disable vertical align for a floated or block image (#1519)

`vertical-align` only moves an image in the line of text, so the image
popup's button did nothing for an image floated left or right, or displayed
as a block. It's now disabled when the image's computed `float` or `display`
says so, which also covers an alignment set by the image properties dialog
or a stylesheet.
